pairs: In die autem vigesimo quarto mensis hujus,
on the twenty-fourth day of the same month,
the sons of Israel came together in fasting and in sackcloth,
Et separatum est semen filiorum Israël ab omni filio alienigena:
And the offspring of the sons of Israel were separated from all the sons of foreigners.
and the iniquities of their fathers.
et legerunt in volumine legis Domini Dei sui,
And they read in the volume of the law of the Lord their God,
And they adored the Lord their God.
Surrexerunt autem super gradum Levitarum Josue,
Then, upon the step of the Levites, Jeshua,
et Chanani: et clamaverunt voce magna ad Dominum Deum suum.
and Chenani rose up. And they cried out in a great voice to the Lord their God.
And the Levites, Jeshua and Kadmiel,
benedicite Domino Deo vestro ab æterno usque in æternum:
Bless the Lord your God, from eternity even to eternity!
et benedicant nomini gloriæ tuæ excelso in omni benedictione et laude.
And blessed be the exalted name of your glory, with all blessing and praise.
tu fecisti cælum, et cælum cælorum,
made heaven, and the heaven of the heavens,
terram, et universa quæ in ea sunt:
the earth and all things that are in it,
maria, et omnia quæ in eis sunt:
the seas and all things that are in them.
And you gave life to all these things.
And the host of heaven adores you.
are the One who chose Abram.
et eduxisti eum de igne Chaldæorum,
And you led him away from the fire of the Chaldeans,
and you gave him the name Abraham.
et invenisti cor ejus fidele coram te,
And you found his heart to be faithful before you.
et percussisti cum eo fœdus ut dares ei terram Chananæi,
And you formed a covenant with him, so that you might give to him the land of the Canaanite,
so that you might give it to his offspring.
And you have fulfilled your words,
Et vidisti afflictionem patrum nostrorum in Ægypto,
And you saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt.
clamoremque eorum audisti super mare Rubrum.
And you heard their outcry beside the Red Sea.
Et dedisti signa atque portenta in Pharaone,
And you gave signs and portents to Pharaoh,
et in omni populo terræ illius:
and to the people of his land.
cognovisti enim quia superbe egerant contra eos:
For you knew that they acted arrogantly against them.
And you made a name for yourself,
just as it is in this day.
And you divided the sea before them,
et transierunt per medium maris in sicco:
and they crossed through the midst of the sea on dry land.
persecutores autem eorum projecisti in profundum,
But their pursuers you cast into the depths,
like a stone into great waters.
Et in columna nubis ductor eorum fuisti per diem,
And in the pillar of cloud, you were their leader by day,
et in columna ignis per noctem,
and in the pillar of fire, by night,
ut appareret eis via per quam ingrediebantur.
so that they might see the way along which they might advance.
You also descended to mount Sinai,
et locutus es cum eis de cælo,
and you spoke with them from heaven.
And you gave them upright judgments,
et sabbatum sanctificatum tuum ostendisti eis: et mandata,
You revealed to them your sanctified Sabbath, and you instructed them in commandments,
et legem præcepisti eis in manu Moysi servi tui.
and the law, by the hand of Moses, your servant.
Panem quoque de cælo dedisti eis in fame eorum,
You also gave them bread from heaven in their hunger,
et aquam de petra eduxisti eis sitientibus,
and you brought forth water from the rock for them in their thirst.
et dixisti eis ut ingrederentur et possiderent terram,
And you said to them that they should enter and possess the land,
super quam levasti manum tuam ut traderes eis.
over which you lifted up your hand so that you might give it to them.
they and our fathers acted arrogantly,
and they did not listen to your commandments.
And they were not willing to hear,
et non sunt recordati mirabilium tuorum quæ feceras eis.
your miracles which you had accomplished for them.
et dederunt caput ut converterentur ad servitutem suam,
so that they would return to their servitude,
et quidem cum fecissent sibi vitulum conflatilem,
Indeed, even when they had made for themselves a molten calf,
who led you away from Egypt!’
tu autem in misericordiis tuis multis non dimisisti eos in deserto:
even so, in the multitude of your mercies, you did not send them away in the desert.
columna nubis non recessit ab eis per diem ut duceret eos in viam,
The pillar of cloud did not withdraw from them by day, so that it might lead them on the way,
et columna ignis per noctem ut ostenderet eis iter per quod ingrederentur.
nor the pillar of fire by night, so that it might show them the way along which they might advance.
And you gave them your good Spirit,
so that he might teach them,
et manna tuum non prohibuisti ab ore eorum,
and you did not withhold your manna from their mouth,
et aquam dedisti eis in siti.
and you gave them water in their thirst.
Quadraginta annis pavisti eos in deserto,
For forty years, you fed them in the desert,
nihilque eis defuit: vestimenta eorum non inveteraverunt,
and nothing was lacking to them; their garments did not grow old,
et pedes eorum non sunt attriti.
and their feet were not worn down.
And you gave them kingdoms and peoples,
and you distributed to them by lot.
And they possessed the land of Sihon,
and the land of the king of Heshbon,
Et multiplicasti filios eorum sicut stellas cæli,
And you multiplied their sons like the stars of heaven.
et adduxisti eos ad terram de qua dixeras patribus eorum ut ingrederentur
And you led them into the land,
about which you had said to their fathers that they would enter and possess it.
Et venerunt filii, et possederunt terram,
And the sons arrived and possessed the land.
et humiliasti coram eis habitatores terræ Chananæos,
And you humbled the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, before them.
et dedisti eos in manu eorum,
And you delivered them into their hands,
and the people of the land,
ut facerent eis sicut placebant illis.
so that they might do with them just as it was pleasing to them.
Ceperunt itaque urbes munitas et humum pinguem,
And so they seized fortified cities and fat soil.
et possederunt domos plenas cunctis bonis:
And they possessed houses filled with all kinds of goods,
And they ate and were satisfied.
et abundaverunt deliciis in bonitate tua magna.
and they abounded with delights from your great goodness.
But they provoked you to wrath,
et projecerunt legem tuam post terga sua:
and they cast your law behind their backs.
qui contestabantur eos ut reverterentur ad te:
who contended with them so that they might return to you.
Et dedisti eos in manu hostium suorum,
And so you gave them into the hand of their enemies,
Et in tempore tribulationis suæ clamaverunt ad te,
And in the time of their tribulation, they cried out to you,
and from heaven you heard them.
et secundum miserationes tuas multas dedisti eis salvatores,
And in accord with your great compassion, you gave to them saviors,
qui salvarent eos de manu hostium suorum.
who might save them from the hand of their enemies.
reversi sunt ut facerent malum in conspectu tuo,
they turned back, so that they did evil in your sight.
et dereliquisti eos in manu inimicorum suorum,
And you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies,
and they cried out to you.
And from heaven you heeded them,
et liberasti eos in misericordiis tuis,
and you freed them many times,
Et contestatus es eos ut reverterentur ad legem tuam.
And you contended with them, so that they might return to your law.
Yet truly, they acted in arrogance,
and they did not listen to your commandments,
and they sinned against your judgments, which,
And they withdrew from offering their shoulder,
et cervicem suam induraverunt, nec audierunt.
and they hardened their neck; neither would they listen.
Et protraxisti super eos annos multos,
And you continued to forbear them for many years.
et contestatus es eos in spiritu tuo per manum prophetarum tuorum:
And you contended with them by your Spirit, through the hand of your prophets.
et tradidisti eos in manu populorum terrarum.
and so you delivered them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
In misericordiis autem tuis plurimis non fecisti eos in consumptionem,
Yet in your very many mercies,
you did not cause them to be consumed,
For you are a compassionate and lenient God.
may you not avert your face from all the hardship that has found us,
ne avertas a facie tua omnem laborem,
from the days of king Assur,
et omnem populum tuum a diebus regis Assur usque in diem hanc.
Et tu justus es in omnibus quæ venerunt super nos:
For you are just, concerning all things that have overwhelmed us.
et patres nostri non fecerunt legem tuam,
and our fathers have not done your law,
and they have not been attentive to your commandments and your testimonies,
et testimonia tua quæ testificatus es in eis.
to which you have testified among them.
And they have not served you,
et in bonitate tua multa quam dederas eis,
in their kingdoms and with your many good things,
et pingui quam tradideras in conspectu eorum,
and in the very wide and fat land,
which you delivered into their sight,
nec reversi sunt a studiis suis pessimis.
nor did they return from their most wicked pursuits.
Ecce nos ipsi hodie servi sumus:
Behold, we ourselves this day are servants.
et terra quam dedisti patribus nostris ut comederent panem ejus, et quæ bona sunt ejus,
And the land, which you gave to our fathers so that they might eat its bread and have its good things,
et nos ipsi servi sumus in ea.
we ourselves are servants within it.
Et fruges ejus multiplicantur regibus quos posuisti super nos propter peccata nostra:
And its fruits are multiplied for the kings, whom you have set over us because of our sins.
And they rule over our bodies,
et jumentis nostris secundum voluntatem suam:
and over our cattle, according to their will.
And we are in great tribulation.
Super omnibus ergo his nos ipsi percutimus fœdus,
Therefore, concerning all of these things,
et scribimus: et signant principes nostri,
we ourselves are forming and writing a covenant,
our Levites, and our priests are signing it.”
